title: Audit folio evidence and statistical controls in Jama’s 2025 structural proposal
statement: I audited the full version of arXiv:2505.02261v1, extending the abstract-level P-R-001 note. The illustrated validation reports a three-branch plant on f74r and reports claimed properties of f74v in Test 10. Folio 74 is excised. The pinned Yale manifest passes from f73v to f75r, and the public folio study documents the cut stub. These reported results need corrected folio identifiers and traceable crops. Test 1 reports seven radial spiral arms on f57v. On the public Yale scan I count four circular text bands and four short radial writing loci. ZL, Takahashi and Friedman each have four circular and four radial loci. Their radial word counts are 1,1,1,2. The paper leaves the boundaries of its seven asserted clusters unspecified. The chi-square section gives worked illustrations. Test 1’s printed counts yield 51.9, while the paper gives 54.2, and both exceed the ordinary five-category uniform critical value. I tested that uniform check and a fixed-marginal transition permutation control on toy random symbol sequences. All 32 nonuniform independent samples reject uniformity, and all 32 sticky Markov samples reject transition independence. The paper’s statistical comparisons can detect these generic forms of structure. An adjudicable test of the particular proposal requires fixed definitions of symbol roles, glyph groups and folio regions, as well as observed counts and a matched baseline.
check: Publish a versioned list of extant folio canvas IDs with image coordinates for each tested group and a deterministic annotation and segmentation procedure. Recompute the claims on that list and freeze predictions for previously unused public scans before inspecting them. Report each observed and expected table, the test statistic and unit of replication. Compare symbol rates and transition structure with frequency-matched independent texts and line-chain controls. A lexical claim verdict would require a specific mapping and language, which this proposal leaves outside its scope.

source.where: Boolean Tests 1, 2, 9 and 10, and Chi-Squared Tests, PDF pp. 16–29
Physical evidence of the missing f74

practice.method: Generate 640 symbols per run from A–E using Python Random for seeds 2025–2056. For independent controls choose uniformly or with weights .40,.35,.10,.08,.07. For the sticky control use those same weighted draws with a 0.55 chance to replace each subsequent draw with the preceding output. Compare one-symbol counts to uniform expected counts using chi-square with four degrees of freedom at alpha .05. For the transition statistic compute Pearson over the adjacent pair table using the product of observed row and column marginals. Use 199 whole-sequence permutations seeded with replicate seed plus 5717, and count ties with the plus-one correction. This transition permutation preserves global marginal frequencies and is a concrete control interpretation of the paper’s illustrative transition comparison.
